name: LoudestTopics
description: Collapsible client-side loudest-topics table for the broker-status window, collapsed by default with the loudest topic and its rate in the header. Expanded it lists the top rows over the selected range with msg/s, bytes/s and a share bar, a '(collecting)' suffix while the window fills, and an overflow footer line. Topics keep their last two segments and ellipsise the head, with the full topic in a tooltip and a copy button on row hover; at narrow widths the share bar drops first, then bytes/s.

props.name: loudest
props.description: LoudestState from the store: { rows: {topic, msgPerSec, bytesPerSec}[], overflowTopics, overflowMsgPerSec, collecting }.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the section is open. Toggled internally by the header button; exposed so a story can force the open state. Per session, never persisted.

notes: Figma is not linked yet; stories use a local LoudestState fixture. Responsive column drops are driven by bind:clientWidth against fixed breakpoints, not the viewport. Topic truncation is CSS only (head span truncates, tail span shrink-0), so the full topic shows whenever it fits.
